title: Páginas sudamericanas
author: Helen Phipps
note: Páginas sudamericanas (Phipps, 1920): a reader about South America, an introduction and 31 chapters on Ecuador, Peru, Bolivia, Chile, Argentina, Paraguay, Uruguay, Brazil, Venezuela and Colombia; each is a reading of its own. Headings: INTRODUCCIÓN and CAPÍTULO I-XXXI after the contents; titles from the contents. Each reading is cut at its CUESTIONARIO or EJERCICIO DE COMPOSICIÓN (questions and exercises); illustrations, footnotes and their markers, and headings in capitals (country, topic, part names) are dropped. Ends at the vocabulary.
